name: weather
description: Operational weather as the national and aviation services published it: station location vintages, observation reports with quality-control flags and corrections, forecast issuance vintages (DWD MOSMIX_L, NWS gridpoint forecasts, TAF, Open-Meteo runs behind a default-off feature), CAP warnings with updates and cancellations, and verification of published forecasts against recorded observations. Composes Climate & Environment stations, Geospatial places, subscriptions and the source-pack runtime.

query_examples.intent: What was observed at a station over two days, with QC flags
query_examples.semantics: current revision per report among revisions acquired by the knowledge cutoff; QC flag verbatim with its common state; the location vintage valid at each report's time; 'no report on record' when empty

query_examples.intent: The forecast for 13:00 as issued before 11:00
query_examples.semantics: per provider, product and model the latest published issuance at or before issued_before that covers the valid time, with lead time; never a Noesis forecast

query_examples.intent: Which warnings were in force at a point at 21:00
query_examples.semantics: CAP chains threaded by references, the latest message sent by as_of decides, areas by Geospatial containment; quoted as issued, no advice

query_examples.intent: How did published temperature forecasts compare with observations
query_examples.semantics: stated pairing rule and tolerance; bias, MAE, RMSE per provider, lead bucket and period with sample sizes and exclusions; no ranking (optional weather-verification feature)

exclusions: own forecasting, nowcasting, downscaling, ensemble blending or bias correction
safety, travel, agricultural or aviation advice
duplicated Climate & Environment record owners (stations, climate series, emissions, reanalysis)
personal weather stations and crowdsourced data
